caption.text: An incense vessel takes the form of a mythical beast. Made in Qianlong-period China, its gilt bronze and gemstone inlays join practical containment with an imagined animal body. The object asks an animal shape to perform a task: to hold incense as well as attract the eye.

proposals.reason: The exact accession is a covered censer, not an animal sculpture assigned a new modern function. Qianlong-period China, gilt bronze and gemstone inlays are museum facts.

caption.text: A brown patina shapes the play of color across this bronze. Pompon’s small Cosette carries the heavy pail described by Victor Hugo. The museum dates this statuette to 1888 and attributes its casting to Siot-Decauville. Material and finish help give weight to the figure’s task.
